svg.title: Harbor Goods private RAG API on Amazon Bedrock
svg.desc: Policy documents in a KMS-encrypted S3 bucket trigger an ingestion job through EventBridge; the Bedrock knowledge base chunks them, embeds them with Titan Embeddings V2 and stores them in an S3 Vectors index. Store staff sign POST /ask with SigV4 through the execute-api VPC endpoint to a private API Gateway with IAM authorization. The ask function in a VPC with no internet route redacts PII, calls Retrieve, keeps at most three sources above the relevance cut-off, and calls Converse on Nova Lite with a guardrail through VPC endpoints; an answer without a valid citation becomes a refusal. make verify gates recall, MRR and refusals offline.
svg.text: HARBOR GOODS · PRIVATE RAG API ON AMAZON BEDROCK
PRIVATE VPC · NO INTERNET OR NAT

g.text: Policy uploads re-index the knowledge base in S3 Vectors
Signed request · PII redacted · only relevant chunks kept
Nova Lite answers under the guardrail, cites or refuses
make verify gates retrieval and refusals offline
